failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of solvent exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 40°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: BPR set below required pressure, leading to insufficient back pressure
failure_modes.mitigation: Adjust BPR to 0.91 bar to ensure proper system pressure

failure_modes.cause: Inadequate sealing or material compatibility issues
failure_modes.mitigation: Regular inspection and maintenance of seals and connections

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.5 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR valve at 0.91 bar setting with solvent flow to ensure stability
Conduct leak test with DMF/AcOH solvent mixture under operational conditions
